items.question: 誰の要求
items.current_answer: Claims must remain within supplied documentary support.

grounding.requirement: README.md: PM review; may narrow claims; may not select new retry or idempotency semantics without owner decision

evidence.ref: Document comparison of README.md and design.md only; no runtime execution
evidence.result: Unsupported optimality/exactly-once claims removed; unresolved choices and revisit conditions explicit

items.gap: Original design claimed optimality and exactly-once without supporting requirements or contract.

resolution.reason: Remove guarantees unsupported by the available documents.

verification.plan: Compare revised claims with supplied documents
verification.result: Revised design explicitly limits simulation evidence and leaves count/idempotency policy unresolved. Documentary check passed.

items.final_answer: This design describes a retry proposal, not an approved delivery guarantee. Unsupported optimality and exactly-once claims are withdrawn.

admitted_limit.limit: Documentation review establishes neither runtime behavior nor product-policy approval.
admitted_limit.revisit_condition: Owner decisions, provider contract and implementation become available.

items.question: なぜこの形 — Why three attempts?
items.current_answer: See revised design; policy is unresolved.

grounding.requirement: README.md: do not silently decide product policy

evidence.characterization_test: README.md supplied summary: simulation sends three times after timeout; report and simulation not independently available

items.gap: No owner policy justifies three; total attempts versus additional retries is ambiguous.

resolution.reason: Keep attempt policy unresolved; simulation cannot justify a count.

verification.plan: Obtain owner policy and provider contract, then check implementation

admitted_limit.limit: Neither the appropriate count nor its counting convention is approved.
admitted_limit.revisit_condition: Product owner supplies acceptable missed/duplicate delivery and latency constraints and approves count/convention; implementation or executable specification enables checking.

items.question: どの前提 — What happens if the operation succeeded but its response was lost?
items.current_answer: See revised design; policy is unresolved.

grounding.requirement: README.md: no new idempotency semantics without owner decision

evidence.ref: Document comparison of README.md and design.md only; no runtime execution
evidence.result: Unsupported optimality/exactly-once claims removed; unresolved choices and revisit conditions explicit

items.gap: Provider completion is possible but response loss leaves the outcome ambiguous; no deduplication contract is supplied.

resolution.reason: Do not choose retry eligibility or idempotency semantics.

verification.plan: Obtain owner policy and provider contract, then check implementation

admitted_limit.limit: Duplicate delivery is possible; neither its probability nor a prevention guarantee is established.
admitted_limit.revisit_condition: Provider owner supplies deduplication/status-query contract or confirms absence; product owner decides acceptable outcome policy; integration checks then assess implementation.

items.question: どう反証 — external side effects and partial failure
items.current_answer: See revised design; policy is unresolved.

grounding.requirement: README.md: keep unresolved items explicit; no policy selection

evidence.ref: Document comparison of README.md and design.md only; no runtime execution
evidence.result: Unsupported optimality/exactly-once claims removed; unresolved choices and revisit conditions explicit

items.gap: Counterexample: provider sends, acknowledgement is lost, worker retries, provider sends again. Ordinary retry wording permits this.

resolution.reason: Record external-side-effect/partial-failure risk without selecting a policy.

verification.plan: Obtain owner policy and provider contract, then check implementation

admitted_limit.limit: Counterexample is hypothetical reasoning, not observed execution; production delivery safety is unverified.
admitted_limit.revisit_condition: Resolve D-003 with provider and product owners, then perform lost-response/provider integration checks before guaranteeing delivery.
